      "source": [
        "import requests\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# ==========================================\n",
        "# PROJECT: RWANDA POPULATION DATA ANALYSIS\n",
        "# Data source: World Bank API\n",
        "# ==========================================\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Loading Rwanda population data...\")\n",
        "\n",
        "url = (\n",
        "    \"https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/RWA/\"\n",
        "    \"indicator/SP.POP.TOTL\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "params = {\n",
        "    \"date\": \"2000:2025\",\n",
        "    \"format\": \"json\",\n",
        "    \"per_page\": 100\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "try:\n",
        "    # 1. Download data from the World Bank\n",
        "    response = requests.get(\n",
        "        url,\n",
        "        params=params,\n",
        "        timeout=30\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    response.raise_for_status()\n",
        "    result = response.json()\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 2. Validate the API response\n",
        "    if (\n",
        "        not isinstance(result, list)\n",
        "        or len(result) < 2\n",
        "        or not isinstance(result[1], list)\n",
        "    ):\n",
        "        raise ValueError(\n",
        "            \"The World Bank API returned an unexpected response.\"\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    records = result[1]\n",
        "\n",
        "    if not records:\n",
        "        raise ValueError(\n",
        "            \"No population data was returned.\"\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 3. Extract valid observations\n",
        "    data = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for item in records:\n",
        "        year = item.get(\"date\")\n",
        "        population = item.get(\"value\")\n",
        "\n",
        "        if year is not None and population is not None:\n",
        "            data.append({\n",
        "                \"Year\": int(year),\n",
        "                \"Population\": int(population)\n",
        "            })\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 4. Create the DataFrame\n",
        "    df = pd.DataFrame(data)\n",
        "\n",
        "    if df.empty:\n",
        "        raise ValueError(\n",
        "            \"No valid population observations were found.\"\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    df = (\n",
        "        df.sort_values(\"Year\")\n",
        "        .drop_duplicates(subset=\"Year\")\n",
        "        .reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 5. Calculate population changes\n",
        "    df[\"Population_Change\"] = (\n",
        "        df[\"Population\"].diff()\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    df[\"Growth_Rate_Percent\"] = (\n",
        "        df[\"Population\"].pct_change() * 100\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 6. Display the results\n",
        "    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 45)\n",
        "    print(\"RWANDA POPULATION DATA ANALYSIS\")\n",
        "    print(\"=\" * 45)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\nFIRST FIVE ROWS:\")\n",
        "    print(df.head().to_string(index=False))\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\nLATEST FIVE AVAILABLE OBSERVATIONS:\")\n",
        "    print(df.tail().to_string(index=False))\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\nSUMMARY STATISTICS:\")\n",
        "    print(\n",
        "        df[[\"Population\", \"Population_Change\",\n",
        "            \"Growth_Rate_Percent\"]]\n",
        "        .describe()\n",
        "        .round(2)\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 7. Calculate total population change\n",
        "    first_year = df.iloc[0][\"Year\"]\n",
        "    last_year = df.iloc[-1][\"Year\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "    first_population = df.iloc[0][\"Population\"]\n",
        "    last_population = df.iloc[-1][\"Population\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "    change = last_population - first_population\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\nKEY FINDINGS:\")\n",
        "    print(f\"First available year: {first_year}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"Last available year: {last_year}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"Population in {first_year}: {first_population:,}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"Population in {last_year}: {last_population:,}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"Total population change: {change:,}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    average_growth = df[\"Growth_Rate_Percent\"].mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "    if pd.notna(average_growth):\n",
        "        print(\n",
        "            \"Average annual percentage change: \"\n",
        "            f\"{average_growth:.2f}%\"\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 8. Visualize population growth\n",
        "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.plot(\n",
        "        df[\"Year\"],\n",
        "        df[\"Population\"],\n",
        "        marker=\"o\"\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.title(\"Rwanda Population Growth\")\n",
        "    plt.xlabel(\"Year\")\n",
        "    plt.ylabel(\"Population\")\n",
        "    plt.grid(True)\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 9. Visualize annual population changes\n",
        "    changes = df.dropna(\n",
        "        subset=[\"Population_Change\"]\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.bar(\n",
        "        changes[\"Year\"],\n",
        "        changes[\"Population_Change\"]\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.title(\"Annual Population Change in Rwanda\")\n",
        "    plt.xlabel(\"Year\")\n",
        "    plt.ylabel(\"Population Change\")\n",
        "    plt.grid(axis=\"y\")\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 10. Save the dataset\n",
        "    csv_filename = \"rwanda_population_data.csv\"\n",
        "\n",
        "    df.to_csv(csv_filename, index=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(f\"\\nDataset saved successfully: {csv_filename}\")\n",
        "    print(\"\\nANALYSIS COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!\")\n",
        "\n",
        "except requests.exceptions.RequestException as error:\n",
        "    print(\"\\nNETWORK ERROR:\")\n",
        "    print(error)\n",
        "    print(\n",
        "        \"Check your internet connection and run the cell again.\"\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError) as error:\n",
        "    print(\"\\nDATA PROCESSING ERROR:\")\n",
        "    print(error)\n",
        "    print(\n",
        "        \"The API response may have changed or the data \"\n",
        "        \"may be temporarily unavailable.\"\n",
        "    )"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
